audit_only.rationale: Length-boundary and random-kept audit rows are otherwise technically eligible. Confirm the current route unless a separate scientific issue is visible. Audit only; no chemistry judgement is required.

known_motif.rationale: S2 detected a known-motif constant-region proposal. It has not been applied. Approve, override, reject, or defer the proposed trim. sequence_core is currently unchanged. Do not auto-approve.

unsupported_chemical_notation.rationale: Unsupported or unparseable chemical notation. The production parser failed closed and did not emit a partial nucleotide sequence. Do not auto-edit or relabel as invalid_alphabet. Inspect the redacted syntax class and decide keep, drop, edit, or defer.

source_type_token_disagreement.rationale: Source Type and parsed token family disagree. Do not silently prefer source metadata or token syntax. Preserve both lines of evidence until a human decision is recorded.

l_rna_stereochemistry.rationale: Source Type is L-RNA. Stereochemistry is biologically meaningful. Do not flatten to ordinary RNA eligibility.

l_dna_stereochemistry.rationale: Source Type is L-DNA. Stereochemistry is biologically meaningful. Do not flatten to ordinary ssDNA parking.

chimeric_molecule.rationale: Source Type is Chimeric. Do not auto-include or auto-park from an inferred dominant token family. Preserve source Type and token-family evidence.

mixed_t_u.rationale: Parsed nucleotide letters contain both T and U after chemical tokenisation. Shared policy classifies mixed T/U, but AptaIndex mixed chemistry may be intentional. Do not silently convert T→U or U→T.

judgement_dependent.rationale: Judgement-dependent technical or chemistry condition. Do not treat this row as an automatic closed-vocabulary reject that can skip review.
